# ccstatusline

> A highly customizable status line formatter for Claude Code CLI. Renders a configurable terminal status line (model info, git branch/state, token/context usage, cost, timers, and other widgets) via an interactive TUI, with support for themes and Powerline-style separators.

## Getting Started

- Runtime requirement: Node.js 22.0.0+ or Bun. The packaged launcher runs on Node.js 14–21 only to display upgrade guidance.
- [Node.js upgrade guide](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/blob/main/docs/NODE-UPGRADE.md): upgrade Node, restart Claude Code with the new runtime, or explicitly run ccstatusline with Bun.
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline#-quick-start): Run with `npx -y ccstatusline@latest` or `bunx -y ccstatusline@latest` — no installation required. Launches an interactive TUI to configure and install the status line into Claude Code's `settings.json`.
- [Windows Support](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS.md): PowerShell setup, fonts, and WSL/Windows Terminal notes.
- [Usage](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): Full widget reference and configuration behavior.

## Configuration

- [ccstatusline settings](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline#-quick-start): Widget and appearance settings are stored at `~/.config/ccstatusline/settings.json` by default. Use `--config <path>` to load and save these settings at a custom file path.
- [Claude Code settings.json format](https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline#-quick-start): ccstatusline writes a `statusLine` command object (`type`, `command`, `padding`, and `refreshInterval` when supported) to Claude Code's `~/.claude/settings.json`, supporting `npx`, `bunx`, or a pinned global `ccstatusline` command. Set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` to override the Claude Code configuration directory; the file is then `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR>/settings.json`.
